typology_areas.note: Buzz, saturation, and net openings are snapshots; only attention trend uses 12m / 9m windows.

quadrants.Q-EMG: momentum ≥ median AND fullness < median → Emerging
quadrants.Q-SAT: momentum < median AND fullness ≥ median → Saturated
quadrants.Q-FADE: momentum < median AND fullness < median → Fading
quadrants.Q-PEAK: momentum ≥ median AND fullness ≥ median → Peak

area_typology.low_evidence: Fewer than 100 active venues (board may still place if ≥ 30)
area_typology.not_enough_data: Missing momentum or fullness rank, or fewer than 30 active venues of this format
area_typology.supporting_ranks: Buzz and net openings rank percentiles are shown on cards only, not used in quadrant placement.
area_typology.saturation_source: Venue-weighted mean of market_cell_stats-derived saturation percentile across all H3 cells in the arrondissement (not gated by site viability).
area_typology.attention_buzz_source: Format-independent: venue-weighted over non-low-signal cells; weights = all-format Sirene active_now.

all.verdict: Some outcome tests reach p<0.05 at n=20, treat as exploratory only; median splits guarantee ~half the city on each axis and this is not a forecast.

kruskal_wallis.power_note: n=20 arrondissements, rank tests have low power; treat as descriptive.
